# Nike Pegasus 41 vs. Brooks Ghost 16

![Nike Mens Pegasus 41 Running Shoes | Rebel Sport](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Yqx6mghzbQ2LSRSo5ysl8-LpfvX3avBT_8WGJbXtvAqh9o9nkk_5wIj413HxM7H8_rw6ya47FFOAMV4o3vtDCSNbDxeRtku3fzPNe2TB0wIYfxTEu_R4fNTrdg61aSl5ivrJlCSzZcFJTHVAp4fKR5TSGH9d5K0pIXQTdrRv1ITk-yQJ9u3kCstTTc_Qk5f5?purpose=fullsize)

**Nike Pegasus 41**

(More versatile feel)

![Brooks Ghost 16 - White - Cream - Pink – Fit2Run](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/rlfvHKxqO2Pel_KYbnY5eAPjSOrAMStF5Ya1Waa3Yp46uyPXJokQXrxGPmrjCeHxNdT6scP_V4Dx-FZpcQ0abfpPTX79Cf1ngTcTOOw4Uu_NNNbXQ9g_QMAwQBX8fNFv0kPN3fL9h6VavtWAjhW_UWtjH3q3q8FgrhmCAtdBEI0kNEfNJwELp34Yn6MF1y66?purpose=fullsize)

**Brooks Ghost 16**

(Comfort-focused)

**Quick verdict\:** The Brooks Ghost 16 is my pick for comfortable everyday mileage and easy runs. The Nike Pegasus 41 is better if you want a firmer, more responsive shoe that can handle different paces.

## 1\. Side-by-side comparison

| Feature | Nike Pegasus 41 | Brooks Ghost 16 |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Cushioning | ReactX + Air Zoom | DNA Loft v3 |
| Ride | Firmer, responsive | Smooth, cushioned |
| Heel drop | 10 mm | 12 mm |
| Weight (men's) | \~10 oz | \~9.5–9.9 oz |
| Stability | Neutral | Neutral |
| Daily running | Very good | Excellent |
| Long runs | Good | Very good |
| Walking | Good | Excellent |
| Faster workouts | Better suited | Less energetic |

**Nike Pegasus 41 – Responsiveness**

- Firmer, more connected feel to the ground.
- Air Zoom units add some snap.
- Better suited to mixing easy runs with faster efforts.
- Can feel harsh under the forefoot for some runners.

**Brooks Ghost 16 – Comfort**

- Smooth, predictable cushioning.
- Comfortable for everyday mileage.
- Great for walking and standing.
- Less lively when picking up the pace.
